Heads-up: The MoA worker review couldn’t run because no worker roles are configured in your environment (preflight failure). Nothing was staged or applied. I proceeded to open the site locally in Chrome.

What I did
- Attempted MoA review: failed (no workers configured), so no changes were proposed/applied by workers.
- Opened index.html in Chrome. If Chrome isn’t installed, it opened in your default browser. Tell me if nothing popped up and I’ll retry with a different path.

Manual quick review (since MoA wasn’t available)
- Accessibility: Good landmarks, skip link, and labels. Add aria-pressed to the theme toggle, Escape-to-close for mobile nav, and ensure focus-visible outlines. Optional: manage aria-hidden for the collapsed mobile menu.
- Security: Add a basic CSP and referrer policy. You’re not using target=_blank, so no rel=noopener changes needed.
- Performance: Fonts are fine with display=swap. Add reduced-motion fallbacks (avoid hover transforms/blur). No render-blocking JS issues.
- Cross-browser: color-mix and backdrop-filter gracefully degrade in some browsers; add safe fallbacks.
- SEO: Title/description are solid. Add robots and optional Twitter card/meta. Canonical can wait until you have a real URL.

Proposed minimal diffs (review and I’ll apply them on approval)
